5. WHEN SHOULD WE PRAY? 
• Anywhere, anytime 
– (Ephesians 6:18) 
 
• Alone (Matthew 6:6) 
– Regular pattern 
– Best part of the day (Mark 1:35) 
 
• With others 
– There’s power in praying together 
– “Again, truly I tell you that if two of you on earth agree about anything they ask for, it 
will be done for them by my Father in heaven.” (Matthew 18:19) 
 
Three simple tips: 
• Keep it real 
• Keep it simple 
• Keep it going 
 
RECOMMENDED READING   
God on Mute by Pete Greig 
 
Too Busy Not to Pray by Bill Hybels 
 
What About Other Religions? by Nicky Gumbel
